verdict.rationale: Extend is a document-processing platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its docs include a dedicated 'Using Extend via MCP' page with 'Connect from your client' and 'Limit available tools' sections, and the Agent Quickstart covers connecting a chat or tool-calling client over MCP. A probe confirmed the official MCP server page exists. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the exposed tools, transport and auth setup (the evidence shows only section headings), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
